# Free_Energy_Synchronization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A principle that couples generalized synchronization of dynamical systems with variational free energy minimization to achieve robust, self-organizing state alignment. Enables TCC architectures to maintain coherent computation across distributed in-network nodes without explicit global clocking.
